summary: The three prior findings are closed. F25 blocks acceptance because the merged blog check skips a symlinked Markdown post that the phase-base check reads and rejects.
blocking_findings: F25 [Blocker] phase-acceptance: The `isFile()` guard at fixtures/blog-posts-loader.ts:61 skips symlinked .md entries. The phase base reads them, and blog.ts:79–85 still discovers them. A blank title on en/acceptance-symlink.md fails by name at the phase base. The audited merge passes all 17 cases without reading that entry. This weakens the K blog validation row, even though no shipped post is a symlink.
evidence: The phase base is 8a126f612abcc258c6c6711d6ac03fa085bbcbff. Acceptance started at a0b8e18e8f0e4529dca74b3a29b8c7741a4bd388, which is also its role base.
The Green result names a0b8e18e8 as green_head and 3bad02148 as its role base. Review A and adversarial testing both pass at a0b8e18e8. No prerequisite needs a test-only HEAD exception.
Test-strategy.md:78–87 excludes Review B, Review C, and UX browser review for this phase. No browser ran.
All 13 Phase 3 tasks have [x] and a valid first-line SHA in the phase history or at the base. Tasks 3.1 and 3.3 cite the base because classification.md has no R1 or R3 rows.
Task 3.2 covers 14 R2 rewrites in adf24e723 and two earlier rewrites under the F11 approval. Task 3.5 uses a separate merge commit, 257a6b0cd.
Twelve class, merge, and remediation receipts match the labeled GREEN and coverage summaries. Each receipt records four zero exits. Line coverage ranges from 91.60% to 92.06%, above the 85.52% floor.

A5: The current plan's class and remediation pass claims match the runner evidence. The test-only adversarial probe commits are not class commits. The current aggregate run has no failing or skipped probe.
A3, A4, A6, and A7 do not apply. The phase diff changes no Measure contract test, framework filter, or track registry.

At the audited HEAD, the three heavy-run gates completed successfully. Coverage passed 1,408 cases in 97 files and reported 92.01% lines (1,659 of 1,803). Type checking reported no diagnostics. Lint reported zero errors and three existing warnings.
The runner reports existing V8 warnings for Markdown remapping. The warnings do not replace the 17 blog validation cases or the named mutation failures.
F22 withdrawn: proof-f22.log records exit 1 on a dot-prefixed regular post. The fresh in-memory en/.acceptance-regular.md input also exits 1 and names that post in the URL-safe slug rule.

F23 withdrawn: proof-f23.log records exit 1 on the color override. A fresh inline --color-slate-900 override on the pricing heading's parent exits 1 and names the property instead of returning a passing ratio.
F24 withdrawn: proof-f24.log records exit 1 on changed gradient stops. A fresh mutation that changes only the last stop to white exits 1 at the --tw-gradient-to assertion.
The fresh focused run passes 47 cases across six files. It includes the contrast guard probes for injected stylesheets, ancestor matches, and grouping rules.
The exact phase diff and commit path inventory contain only www test files, test fixtures, and plan.md. No production file, blog post, or tutor-commission test changed.

The merged blog suite still runs 15 rules and two discovery cases. proof-blog-merge.log records named post failures. A fresh blank title on the regular en/1-district-1-quality-school.md file produces one named failure and 16 passes.

F25 comparison: The same file-system stand-in supplies acceptance-symlink.md and a blank title to both suites. The phase base reads it and fails once by name. The audited HEAD lists it, never reads it, and passes all 17 cases.
F25 is a loss versus 8a126f612, not an equal pre-existing limit. The F22 remediation changed the same guard line and retained its isFile() exclusion.

The named failure on a regular post meets the narrow condition at classification.md:250–255. The raw reduction from 3,175 to 1,408 is 55.65%. The independent K gate still fails, so the merge cannot support a compliant 20% result at this HEAD.
With no credit for the 1,709 cases removed by the merge, the comparison count is 3,117 and the reduction is 1.83%. The pilot report remains a Phase 4 task.
The probes ran in memory. No tracked file needed restoration.
